prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production website hero/banner illustration for a serious community discussion review workbench, landscape canvas 1536 by 512 pixels, exact 3:1 aspect ratio.

Create a NEW polished composition using the two input images only as character identity and visual style references, NOT as existing layout.
Image 1 is the approved BLUE whale-girl inspector identity and cool painterly art-direction reference. Discard its split concept-sheet layout, typography and separate icon column.
Image 2 is the community artist's BLACK whale-girl identity reference. Adapt her into the SAME subdued painterly medium as Image 1. Do not copy her sticker outline, text, tiny companion whale, desk logo or speech bubble.

Whole scene: one unified night-time community duty room, a continuous wooden work desk and dim discussion noticeboard behind it. No panel divisions. Large calm negative space on the LEFT 43–48 percent of the entire canvas, dark low-contrast deep sea navy close to #14232c, gently textured and uncluttered, suitable for HTML page title and controls overlaid later. No characters, bright objects, lamps or screens in that left text-safe area. All human activity and the lit work surface occupy the RIGHT 52–57 percent. Both characters naturally share the same desk, cooperate and are looking at their own work rather than posing at the viewer.

At approximately 63% of image width is the BLACK whale girl representing DSH orchestration and execution: very clear chibi 2.5-head-tall proportions, large round head, tiny torso and short arms, NOT an adult woman. Long black wavy hair, blue-gray eyes, white scalloped lace/wave headband, horizontal black whale-fin ears, black-and-white compact uniform with ivory collar. No monocle and no blue inspector cape. Seated at the main desktop workstation, hands clearly operating a small keyboard and touchpad. Her monitor is angled so the viewer can see a few readable-as-geometry tool-workflow elements: connected simple node blocks, file tile stacks, small check marks. No letters or numerals. Her function must read as coordinating tools and moving work forward. Place an input/output document tray just to her right, linking her computer work to the other character's records.

At approximately 84% of image width is the BLUE whale girl representing Whale Watch's understanding of context and verification of evidence: preserve Image 1's distinctive round chibi face, dark navy blue long wavy hair with muted cyan tips, blue-gray eyes, white wave headband, small blue side bow, whale-fin ears and curved ahoge. Preserve the delicate old-gold transparent monocle over HER LEFT eye (viewer-right), dark navy short cape and short jacket, ivory standing collar and small whale-tail gold clasp. A small badge may carry only a speech-bubble-and-magnifying-glass symbol, no writing. She is leaning slightly over a clipboard, looking DOWN at her own notes and comparing them with open discussion sheets on the shared desk. One hand holds the clipboard close to her body, PAPER SIDE FACING HER, so the VIEWER SEES THE PLAIN DARK BACK OF THE BOARD; the other hand holds a small pencil at its upper edge, clearly writing or checking. Discussion sheets on desk have tiny abstract speech bubbles, avatar circles and line marks only, no actual text. Her action must clearly differ from the black whale girl at the computer. The two are colleagues, not opposites or combatants.

Composition and rendering: medium-wide view, both chibi figures large enough that their hands and work props are legible. Heads, ahoges, hands and main tools comfortably clear of top and bottom edges with safe margins, especially top 10%. Compact chibi bodies can be largely seated behind the desk; no need to show feet or tails. The shared desktop forms a gentle visual handoff from black character's computer/files to blue character's clipboard/discussion sheets. Soft blurred background discussion board, one small warm shaded table lamp at the far right, few upright folders, very restrained environment. Avoid a large monitor or gadget obscuring either character's face or hands.

Style: serious and deep yet unmistakably cute Q-version characters; cool matte painterly illustration, hand-painted edges, low saturation deep navy, blue-gray, charcoal, ivory, little antique gold; restrained warm desk light. Gentle concentrated expressions, not angry, exaggerated or sugary. Cohesive scene lighting and painted texture, no stickers pasted into a background. Maintain the reference's refined face rendering but don't turn it into bright glossy gacha art.

Absolutely no typography, text, titles, slogans, watermarks, numbers, brand logos, icon comparison columns, decorative borders or split-screen layout. No lighthouse, lantern carried or worn by character, weapons, warfare, police imagery, futuristic metal HUDs or giant science-fiction displays. If a whale tail is visible it must have a real stalk joining the center of TWO lateral flukes with a concave notch between the flukes; preferably keep tails hidden naturally behind the desk. Final deliverable is only the wide illustration with the left negative-space region intentionally ready for real frontend HTML.

references.role: Approved blue whale-girl character identity and visual style; not layout
Community artist black whale-girl identity reference, not a universal official DSH design

review.composition: Unified 3:1 shared community duty desk. Black character operates computer workflow, blue character checks discussion records with inward-facing clipboard. No in-image words, no split panels or logo.
review.deviations: Generated canvas is 2172 × 724 rather than requested 1536 × 512, retaining exact 3:1 ratio. The left upper 40% remains calm for HTML. Monitor/desk extend to lower-left at about 33%, so title and controls should not overlay the lower-left desk. Ahoge has about 4% top clearance rather than requested 10%; use the full image without a close vertical crop.
